verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a hosted coding-agent platform like Codegen, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a cloud-hosted service reached through a GitHub App, Slack and Linear integrations, an API, an SDK, and a CLI. The CLI wraps local Claude Code and sends telemetry to the cloud, but that is not self-hosting the core product, and no deployable self-hosted distribution or on-prem option is documented.
